author: TeIq
content: CI test failure root-caused: NOT a test bug. CI log shows 'FATAL: could not write to file pg_wal/xlogtemp.33: No space left on device' when starting Postgres testcontainer for wellness_exposure. The GitHub runner ran out of disk after spinning up ~50 testcontainers across the workspace test suite. Both wellness tests PASS LOCALLY (4/4 against testcontainers, 2/2 against polaris-pg-live). Fix: add disk-cleanup step before cargo test (standard pattern: prune /usr/share/dotnet, /usr/local/lib/android, /opt/ghc — frees ~25 GB on ubuntu-latest).
